title: Harness output spill recovery recursively spills and hides source continuation
wanted_capability: Bound file/search/outline results at the producer and preserve source identity, continuation, errors, and async handles through model-facing rendering. Recovery of oversized output must make progress without creating another dump.
missing_primitive: Source-aware bounded reader and metadata-preserving output envelope
fallback_used: Read original source paths in small ranges; use code-mode to select fields before text().
notes: Synthetic fixture: 210954-byte numbered file_read became 2248-byte preview; subsequent numbered recovery payloads grew to 219851 and 228749 bytes and all spilled. Original continuation hint was absent from inline output. Related addressed gap-0c902d6d caps search at 24000 bytes, still above the 16384-byte harness cap. See design/bro-harness/model-facing-tools-audit.md.
resolution_note: Addressed on fix/harness-tool-contracts: bounded exact source pages and UTF-8 byte continuation, no generic dump recursion, bounded source/search/shell/listing/web output with explicit omission metadata. Source end-of-line bytes survive paging. Focused suite and full workspace nextest (6770 passed), clippy, concurrency lint, formatting, and rebuilt isolate probes pass.
